It is now also about who can raise the most capital, handle the biggest enterprise demand, and convince investors that they are not just building tools, but the infrastructure layer of the next technology economy. Anthropic has moved to the centre of that race with a new $65 billion Series H funding round, valuing the company at $965 billion. The round makes Anthropic the most valuable artificial intelligence startup in Silicon Valley and places it ahead of OpenAI on reported private-market valuation. The new valuation suggests investors now see Anthropic as a central AI company in its own right, not simply as an alternative to OpenAI. The AI capital race is not limited to Anthropic and OpenAI.

news.raw_snippet: **The AI boom has led to a wave of sky-high valuations for** **companies that managed to be among the first out of the gate.** Anthropic is nearing a USD 1 tn valuation on the back of its most recent funding round, overtaking OpenAI which was worth around USD 852 bn in March. **More recently, it’s the second wave of AI firms that’s increasingly garnering more investment attention** and making b’naires of their founders, Bloomberg reports. **Who’s on the list?** Topping the list with a USD 60.2 bn valuation is Cerebras Systems, making b’naires of its founders Andrew Feldman (worth USD 2.8 bn) and Sean Lie (USD 1.5 bn). Open-weight AI model developer Reflection’s USD 27 valuation has made its founders worth USD 4 bn each, while customer service software firm Sierra’s founders are worth USD 4.2 bn and USD 3.7 bn.

news.title: Digitide任命Sameer Ahluwalia为CEO以扩张AI及数字服务业务
news.snippet: Digitide任命Sameer Ahluwalia为CEO，聚焦AI-led transformation（AI主导转型）及大型数字服务项目，加速业务扩张战略。
news.raw_snippet: ## The company is focusing on AI-led transformation, large-deal acquisition, profitability and international expansion as it enters its next phase of growth. Digitide Solutions has appointed Sameer Ahluwalia as chief executive officer and executive director, effective June 1, as the company looks to scale its AI and digital services business and accelerate its next phase of growth. The company has placed its focus on AI-led business transformation, operational discipline, profitability and expansion across domestic and international markets. According to the company, Ahluwalia will strengthen operational discipline, scale AI and digital capabilities, accelerate large-deal acquisition and expand the company's presence across key markets. The company said Ahluwalia's immediate priorities will include scaling its AI and digital practice, improving profitability and pursuing larger strategic opportunities across “domestic and international markets”. Digitide Solutions’ chairman, Ajit Isaac, said Ahluwalia's experience across business services, global operations and AI-led transformation aligns closely with the company's next phase of growth.
